_why: What the golden harness itself may stop pinning (bin/goldens/golden_manifest.py): <cases> names a dropped case or cell, or a cell newly declared not applicable, as <set>.<list>:<item> (e.g. host_matrix.cells:medchron/busy); <normaliser> names a normaliser added, changed or removed (e.g. host_matrix_normal._ULID). Each entry is exact, reviewed with the PR, and cleared after it merges. The medchron parallel reading PR (2026-11-19): page reading now sends 8 pages at once (vision.VISION_WORKERS), which shuffles the order its requests are sent in; the frozen reader cell pins send order, so reader_lanes.py runs the medchron cell's page reading with one worker (VISION_WORKERS=1). The requests themselves are unchanged.
